explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/878: with f(n) = Σ_{p | n} p^{ℓ_p}, n ∈ [p^{ℓ_p}, p^{ℓ_p+1}), the page records Erdős's result limsup (1/x) Σ_{n<x} f(n)/n = ∞. In Lean f n = Σ_{p ∈ primeFactors n} p^{Nat.log p n} (Nat.log p n = ⌊log_p n⌋, matching ℓ_p), H x = Σ_{1 ≤ n < x} f(n)/n, and the statement ∀ C, ∃ᶠ x, C ≤ H x / x is exactly limsup H(x)/x = ∞ over integer x (the n = 0 term is excluded, as on the page where n ranges over positive integers). Faithful.
